name: study
description: A full-stack e-learning platform (MERN stack) where students browse and purchase courses, instructors build and publish courses through a step-by-step wizard, and admins manage course categories. Built with a React frontend and a Node.js/Express/MongoDB backend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server-fixed-v3/server" "npm run dev --prefix studynotion-frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run start --prefix server-fixed-v3/server" "npm run dev --prefix studynotion-frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server-fixed-v3/server && npm install --prefix studynotion-frontend
